title: nan
authors: Zhang L.; Zhou X.; Li D.; Yang Z.
key_contribution: Presents HCCNet, a hybrid coupled cooperative localization network combining camera, UWB, and IMU with D-RANSAC for robust indoor UAV localization in GPS-denied environments, validated experimentally.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
